learning-to-drive

Learner: I've passed my theory test! Now I need to book my practical. Any tips for the test itself?
Instructor: Congratulations! The practical lasts about forty minutes. The examiner will ask you to follow directions, do an independent drive using sat-nav, and perform one manoeuvre — like parallel parking or pulling up on the right.
Learner: What are the most common reasons people fail?
Instructor: Observation at junctions is the biggest one — not checking mirrors properly. Also, positioning on roundabouts and hesitation at junctions. Confidence matters as much as accuracy.
Learner: I'm nervous about roundabouts — especially the big multi-lane ones.
Instructor: We'll practise those specifically. Remember: mirror, signal, position. Use the left lane for turning left or going straight ahead, right lane for turning right. Give way to traffic from the right.
Learner: What happens if I pass? Can I drive on the motorway straight away?
Instructor: Yes — since 2018, newly qualified drivers can drive on motorways. But you're on probation for two years: if you get six points, your licence is revoked and you start again. Drive carefully and build your experience gradually.
